46  import java.util.Collection;

53  /**
54   * Docker storage container.
55   */
56  public final class DockerStorageContainer extends DockerE2EContainer implements StorageContainer {
57      
58      private final StorageContainerOption option;
59      
60      private final String scenario;
61      
62      @Getter
63      private final int majorVersion;
64      
65      @Getter
66      private final Map<String, DataSource> actualDataSourceMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
67      
68      @Getter
69      private final Map<String, DataSource> expectedDataSourceMap = new LinkedHashMap<>();
70      
71      public DockerStorageContainer(final String containerImage, final StorageContainerOption option, final String scenario) {
72          super(option.getDatabaseType().toLowerCase(), getContainerImage(containerImage, option));
73          this.option = option;
74          this.scenario = scenario;
75          majorVersion = new DockerImageVersion(getContainerImage(containerImage, option)).getMajorVersion();
76      }
77      
78      private static String getContainerImage(final String containerImage, final StorageContainerOption option) {
79          Preconditions.checkNotNull(option, "Can not support database type `%s`", option.getDatabaseType());
80          return Strings.isNullOrEmpty(containerImage) ? option.getCreateOption().getDefaultImageName() : containerImage;
81      }
82      
83      @Override
84      protected void configure() {
85          setCommands();
86          addEnvironments();
87          mountConfigurations();
88          mountSQLFiles();
89          setPrivilegedMode();
90          withExposedPorts(getExposedPort());
91          setWaitStrategy();
92      }
93      
94      private void setCommands() {
95          String command = option.getCreateOption().getCommand();
96          if (!Strings.isNullOrEmpty(command)) {
97              setCommand(command);
98          }
99      }
100     
101     private void addEnvironments() {
102         option.getCreateOption().getEnvironments().forEach(this::addEnv);
103     }
104     
105     private void mountConfigurations() {
106         mapResources(new MountConfigurationResourceGenerator(option.getType(), option.getCreateOption()).generate(majorVersion, scenario));
107     }
108     
109     private void mountSQLFiles() {
110         if (option.getCreateOption().isSupportDockerEntrypoint()) {
111             mapResources(new MountSQLResourceGenerator(option.getType(), option.getCreateOption()).generate(majorVersion, scenario));
112         }
113     }
114     
115     private void setPrivilegedMode() {
116         if (option.getCreateOption().withPrivilegedMode()) {
117             withPrivilegedMode(true);
118         }
119     }
120     
121     private void setWaitStrategy() {
122         String user = option.getCreateOption().isSupportDockerEntrypoint()
123                 ? StorageContainerConstants.CHECK_READY_USER
124                 : option.getCreateOption().getDefaultUserWhenUnsupportedDockerEntrypoint().orElse("");
125         String password = option.getCreateOption().isSupportDockerEntrypoint()
126                 ? StorageContainerConstants.CHECK_READY_PASSWORD
127                 : option.getCreateOption().getDefaultPasswordWhenUnsupportedDockerEntrypoint().orElse("");
128         setWaitStrategy(new JdbcConnectCheckingWaitStrategy(() -> createConnection(option.getConnectOption(), getURL(), user, password)));
129         withStartupTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(option.getCreateOption().getStartupTimeoutSeconds()));
130     }
131     
132     private String getURL() {
133         return option.getCreateOption().getDefaultDatabaseName(majorVersion)
134                 .map(optional -> option.getConnectOption().getURL("localhost", getMappedPort(), optional))
135                 .orElseGet(() -> option.getConnectOption().getURL("localhost", getMappedPort()));
136     }
137     
138     @SneakyThrows(SQLException.class)
139     @Override
140     protected void containerIsStarted(final InspectContainerResponse containerInfo) {
141         if (option.getCreateOption().isSupportDockerEntrypoint()) {
142             return;
143         }
144         try (
145                 Connection connection = createConnection(option.getConnectOption(), option.getConnectOption().getURL("localhost", getMappedPort()),
146                         option.getCreateOption().getDefaultUserWhenUnsupportedDockerEntrypoint().orElse(""),
147                         option.getCreateOption().getDefaultPasswordWhenUnsupportedDockerEntrypoint().orElse(""))) {
148             for (String each : new MountSQLResourceGenerator(option.getType(), option.getCreateOption()).generate(majorVersion, scenario).keySet()) {
149                 SQLScriptUtils.execute(connection, each);
150             }
151         }
152     }
153     
154     private static Connection createConnection(final StorageContainerConnectOption connectOption, final String url, final String user, final String password) throws SQLException {
155         try {
156             Class.forName(connectOption.getDriverClassName());
157             return DriverManager.getConnection(url, user, password);
158         } catch (final ClassNotFoundException ex) {
159             throw new SQLException("Driver class not found: " + connectOption.getDriverClassName(), ex);
160         }
161     }
162     
163     @Override
164     protected void postStart() {
165         actualDataSourceMap.putAll(createAccessDataSources(DatabaseEnvironmentManager.getDatabaseNames(scenario, Type.ACTUAL)));
166         expectedDataSourceMap.putAll(createAccessDataSources(DatabaseEnvironmentManager.getDatabaseNames(scenario, Type.EXPECTED)));
167     }
168     
169     private Map<String, DataSource> createAccessDataSources(final Collection<String> databaseNames) {
170         return databaseNames.stream().distinct().collect(Collectors.toMap(Function.identity(), this::createAccessDataSource, (previous, current) -> previous, LinkedHashMap::new));
171     }
172     
173     /**
174      * Create access data source.
175      *
176      * @param dataSourceName data source name
177      * @return access data source
178      */
179     public DataSource createAccessDataSource(final String dataSourceName) {
180         return StorageContainerUtils.generateDataSource(getJdbcUrl(dataSourceName), StorageContainerConstants.OPERATION_USER, StorageContainerConstants.OPERATION_PASSWORD, 20);
181     }
182     
183     /**
184      * Get JDBC URL.
185      *
186      * @param dataSourceName datasource name
187      * @return JDBC URL
188      */
189     public String getJdbcUrl(final String dataSourceName) {
190         return option.getConnectOption().getURL(getHost(), getMappedPort(), getToBeConnectedDataSourceName(dataSourceName));
191     }
192     
193     /**
194      * Get to be connected data source name.
195      *
196      * @param dataSourceName datasource name
197      * @return to be connected data source name
198      */
199     public String getToBeConnectedDataSourceName(final String dataSourceName) {
200         return Strings.isNullOrEmpty(dataSourceName) ? option.getCreateOption().getDefaultDatabaseName(majorVersion).orElse("") : dataSourceName;
201     }
202     
203     /**
204      * Get database container exposed port.
205      *
206      * @return exposed database container port
207      */
208     public int getExposedPort() {
209         return option.getCreateOption().getPort();
210     }
211     
212     /**
213      * Get database container mapped port.
214      *
215      * @return mapped database container port
216      */
217     public int getMappedPort() {
218         int exposedPort = getExposedPort();
219         Ports.Binding[] bindings = getCurrentContainerInfo().getNetworkSettings().getPorts().getBindings().get(ExposedPort.tcp(exposedPort));
220         Preconditions.checkNotNull(bindings, "Database port (%s) is not mapped", exposedPort);
221         return Integer.parseInt(bindings[0].getHostPortSpec());
222     }
223     
224     @Override
225     public String getAbbreviation() {
226         return getName();
227     }
228     
229     @Override
230     public Map<String, String> getLinkReplacements() {
231         Map<String, String> result = new HashMap<>();
232         for (String each : getNetworkAliases()) {
233             for (Integer exposedPort : getExposedPorts()) {
234                 result.put(each + ":" + exposedPort, getHost() + ":" + getMappedPort(exposedPort));
235             }
236         }
237         return result;
238     }
239 }
